name: UnityOctree

source.verification: GitHub HTTPS commit archive (2026-11-18, commit bbc473571c8a0879024077a928ca658a52ecbd99 of 2021-06-08, master). There are no releases, so it is pinned to a commit. There is no signature. The commit matches the reference in Docs/Design/SpatialIndex.ko.md.

notes: Provenance record for benchmark comparison group B (Docs/Design/SpatialIndex.ko.md section 9.1, decision 9). Only LICENCE was extracted byte for byte from the commit archive. No original source file is kept in the repository.

Programs/SpatialIndexBench/Private/UnityOctreePort.h and UnityOctreePort.cpp re-implement in C++ the behavior and data structures of Scripts/BoundsOctree.cs and Scripts/BoundsOctreeNode.cs at this commit. No source text was copied. Each port file carries the BSD 2-Clause notice and the commit, and its header comment lists every deviation from the original (double instead of float, filter mask, shared allocator instead of GC, C# List rules, added sphere/nearest/count traversals).

The port is built only into the SpatialIndexBench development executable. It goes into no engine module, test executable or SDK, so it has no embeddedIn. If a binary containing the port is ever distributed, the notice must be reproduced (binaryNoticeRequired).
